boundary_convention: receipt instant in IST truncated to the minute must lie in [15:10,15:30] (close) or [09:15,09:45] (open), inclusive, on the session date; the slot is scheduling intent only

cases.description: In-window close and open quotes, both indices.
Slot 15:10 (intent) but the response arrived 15:05:02: not in the close window.
Upper close boundary: last millisecond of minute 15:30.
Final 15:30 poll answered 15:31:00.000 (late); 15:25 in window: close rests on 15:25.
Only the late final poll: no qualifying close.
Upper open boundary: last millisecond of minute 09:45.
Late final opening poll: slot 09:45 answered 09:46:01.
Next day the ATM CE strike/side appears under a DIFFERENT instrument key (roll); the other five pair.
NF next-day response carries a different expiry for the same keys; BNF normal.
Next day the ATM CE key reports a different strike with a two-sided book; the other five pair.
At 15:30 the ATM CE key reports a different strike (two-sided); 15:10 was clean: close rests on 15:10.

verdict_format: per contract PAIR@<close slot> or REFUSED:<reason>; per index the distinct verdicts, each with xN when not all six agree, sorted and joined by "; "
